title: Median product price
statementMd:
Compute the median product price. With an even number of products, average the two middle prices.

Expected columns: `median_price`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Order by price, number the rows, and keep the middle one or two.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH r AS (SELECT price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY price) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM products) SELECT AVG(price) AS median_price FROM r WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
